title: debrief.facts
description: host → server → client (relayed unchanged). What the team learned: facts collected during the mission, Codex entries unlocked, the Lessons Learned card after a failure, and the "your rocket vs. a real one" comparison.

codexIds.description: Codex entries unlocked during the mission.

lessonId.description: Lessons Learned card earned; null when none.

comparison.description: Comparison with a real rocket; null when not available.

twin.description: Name of the real vehicle compared with.

yourMassT.description: Lift-off mass of the team's rocket, t.

twinMassT.description: Lift-off mass of the real vehicle, t (real-world approximate).

yourDvMs.description: Total Δv of the team's rocket, m/s.

twinDvMs.description: Total Δv of the real vehicle, m/s (real-world approximate).

DataId.description: Identifier of an entry in the shared game data (`data/`): part, part category, contract, test, anomaly card, minigame, fact, codex entry, callout, console request, award, objective, validation rule, cosmetic. 1–48 characters.

TextRef.description: Reference to localised player-visible text. The protocol never carries free display text: `key` is a key of `data/strings/<lang>.json`, and `args` supplies substitution values. Receivers format numbers and units locally.

args.description: Substitution values by placeholder name. String values must themselves be data ids or string-table keys, never user text.
